# dist

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Built by | `tools/` |
| Rebuilt | In every PR that changes a source |
| Guard | The drift check blocks a stale `dist/` (decision 21) |
| Pulled by | Consumers, at a release tag (decision 10) |

## Social cards (`social/`, 1280×640 JPEG)

Every card is AI-made with FIBO 2.0 (decision 37), labelled on the image and in its IPTC metadata (decision 8). Built by `art/render/fibo_cards.py` (decision 39); photo sources in `art/render/src/SOURCES.md`.

| Card | Image | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| `coloradostartups.org.jpg` | Boulder: an AI painting of the Flatirons from a photo, with a city of elves and dragons | Photo by Jimbo Herndan, [public domain](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flatirons_2007.jpg) |
| `brand.jpg` | Golden: an AI painting of Table Mountain from a photo, with a dwarf kingdom's great gate | Photo by James St. John, [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) ([source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lava_flows_capping_North_Table_Mountain_%26_South_Table_Mountain_(Denver_Formation,_Upper_Cretaceous;_Golden,_Colorado,_USA).jpg)), edited |
| `claudius.jpg` | Claudius, a gnome engineer and loyal companion | AI-made, no photo |
| `link.jpg` | Linken, a gnome hero | AI-made, no photo |
| `legallas.jpg` | Legallas, an elf ranger | AI-made, no photo |

## Places (`places/`, 1440×720 JPEG)

Each Colorado place as one bright, hand-painted scene repainted from a real photo (decision 43). AI-made with FIBO 2.0, labelled in IPTC metadata; no wordmark. Built by `art/render/fibo_cards.py` (`painted`, then `places`).

| File | Place | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| `boulder.jpg` | Boulder (Photon Mountain): the Flatirons, a city of elves and dragons | Photo by Jimbo Herndan, [public domain](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flatirons_2007.jpg) |
| `golden.jpg` | Golden (Photon Mountain): Table Mountain, a dwarf kingdom's great gate | Photo by James St. John, [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) ([source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lava_flows_capping_North_Table_Mountain_%26_South_Table_Mountain_(Denver_Formation,_Upper_Cretaceous;_Golden,_Colorado,_USA).jpg)), edited |
| `denver.jpg` | Denver (Photon Mountain): the skyline, a citadel of men | Photo by USFWS Mountain-Prairie, [public domain](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Denver_Skyline_(15242286069).jpg) |
| `springs.jpg` | Colorado Springs (Space Peak): Pikes Peak, a gryphon aerie | Photo by Huttarl, [CC BY 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/) ([source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pikes_Peak_from_CO_Springs.jpg)), edited |
| `fortcollins.jpg` | Fort Collins (Fusion Canyon): Poudre Canyon, gnome workshops and round-door burrow homes | Photo by Charles Willgren, [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) ([source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Poudre_Canyon,_Greyrock_trail.jpg)), edited |
